Read all 18 owned units (s0002–s0019) in Chinese, plus each owned person's supplied items and context items. No birth or age is stated in these units. The only deaths are Hui (s0009 廆卒, AD 333 via Jinshu 108 咸和八年), Qidegui (s0010 奔死於外) and Zhao (s0014 皝殺昭), and all three are captured. The conversions are correct at year level: 建武初 is 317, 太甯末 is 325–326 and 咸和九年 is 334, with no Julian/Gregorian issue. The post-Hui sequence correctly uses a 333–334 event window rather than a chosen year. The two defects from the earlier current-source review are fixed in this candidate: claim-66 now has westernBounds onOrAfter 317, and hints-p004 is ["AD 333-334"]. All 70 items and 17 people are supported, and there are no findings. Compared with the prior candidate, the 28 supplied units (Chinese and English), all 70 items, the 14 context items and the people records are byte-identical in content; only the job ID, sourceHash, extractionHash and the order of the s0024 unitPeople list differ, so the new sourceHash reflects text outside this packet. Every check was still redone against the Chinese. English check: only the en field was supplied, and no definite English defect was found in the owned units; the literal translation field was not supplied and is unchecked. This is not chapter or publication approval.
Independent review of current job 79109d9ad11413625eb0 (attachment SHA-256 6478f5af…079469 verified). I read all 9 owned units, s0020–s0028, in Chinese and checked every owned person's supplied chronology, including read-only contextItem claim-147. No birth or age is stated. The only deaths are Muti and Siluohou (s0021, 皆斬之), both recorded as AD 334. 咸和九年 is AD 334: Xianhe was Emperor Cheng's era, running from 326 until Xiankang began on the first day of 335. This is year precision only. The 旬余 and 圍守二旬 intervals keep the Liucheng fights in the same year. The s0020 backing of Ren correctly keeps a 333–334 window rather than a chosen year. hints-p010 ["AD 333-334","AD 334"] matches Duan Liao's own events. All 36 items and 10 people are supported, with no chronology omissions. Note, not a date defect: unitPeople maps 遼 in s0024 to p157, a second Duan Liao record outside this job, which identity jobs own. This packet supplies no literal field, so the literal translation was not checked, and repeated uses were not checked here because the host supplies them. No full chapter or publication approval is given.
I read all 10 owned units (s0029–s0038), all 36 owned items, and all 10 owned people against the Chinese and the ZZTJ annals for 咸和九年, 咸康元年 and 咸康二年. 30 checks are supported: the 是歲 investiture and Liaodong campaign items are AD 334 (ZZTJ agrees); Huang's 335–336 window, Ren's AD 336 date, and Guangwu's retrospective classification are sound. Six checks are incorrect: the 咸康初 Feng Yi raid on Sheyiyu and the Hun River pursuit (claims 213, 216, 381, 382 and hints p033, p034) give an unattested exact AD 335 where only a 335–336 window is supported. No births, deaths, or ages are omitted in the owned units. Only the English (en) text was supplied, so the literal field was not checked. This is not chapter or publication approval.

The hints for Duan Liao, Duan Lan and Murong Jun now include their dated context activity. No omitted births, deaths or ages were found, and no findings remain. English: only the supplied en field was read, and no definite defect was found in the owned units; any other literal field was not supplied and is unchecked.
